ns0:info.ns0:headline: Volcanic activity report for Krakatau (Indonesia), 8 October-14 October 2026
ns0:info.ns0:description: The Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG) reported an increase in low-level eruptive activity at Krakatau starting in early October. During 21 September-9 October seismicity indicating both shallow and deep magmatic processes did not significantly increase. Minor white-to-black ash plumes were occasionally visible in webcam images rising as high as 50 m above the crater, though weather conditions sometimes prevented views. Satellite data indicated low sulfur dioxide emissions as high as 238 tons per day and low-level thermal anomalies. Five eruptive events were recorded during 6-8 October, followed by nine eruptive events just on 9 October, indicating increasing low-level activity. The Alert Level was raised to 3 (on a scale of 1-4) at 2100 on 9 October and the public was advised to stay 5 km away from summit.
ns0:info.ns0:contact: Source: Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG, also known as CVGHM)

ns0:info.ns0:headline: Volcanic activity report for Manam (Papua New Guinea), 8 October-14 October 2026
ns0:info.ns0:description: The Darwin Volcanic Ash Advisory Centre (VAAC) reported that ash plumes from Manam rose to 2.1 km (7,000 ft) a.s.l. and drifted E, NE, N, and NW during 8-9 and 11-13 October.
ns0:info.ns0:contact: Source: Darwin Volcanic Ash Advisory Centre (VAAC)
